author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕಷ್ಟಗಳ ಮರೆಮಾಚಿ ದುಡಿಯುತಲೆ ಮನೆಗಾಗಿ
ಇಷ್ಟಗಳ ನಿನಗಾಗೆ ತ್ಯಾಗ ಮಾಡಿಹನು
ನಿಷ್ಠೆಯಿಂದಲೆ ಗಳಿಸಿ ಜಗನಿನಗೆ ಪರಿಚಯಿಸಿ
ಶಿಷ್ಟನಾಗುವ ಜನಕ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Hiding his hardships, working for the home,
he sacrificed his own wishes for you;
earning with integrity, introducing you to the world,
your father becomes a noble one, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: A father hides his struggles, gives up his own desires for his family, earns honestly and opens the world to his child. Honour him.
